title: BioLoom: Scaling Biomedical Vision-Language Models by Learning from the Structure of Scientific Articles
abstract: arXiv:2611.33151v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The development of biomedical vision-language models (VLMs) with contrastive image-text pretraining has been driven by scaling to increasingly large and diverse image-text datasets. Beyond scaling, further progress can come from learning richer representations from existing data. We hypothesize that the structure of scientific literature itself provides an additional source of supervision: figures, panels, captions, and accompanying article text encode rich relationships across modalities. Yet, treating these as independent image-text pairs overlooks their relationships. To address this limitation, we incorporate these structural relationships into contrastive image-text supervision. We preserve exact image-text matches while introducing weaker positive supervision for related pairs, such as a panel and the caption of a sibling panel. translated_title: BioLoom：通过学习科学文章的结构来扩展生物医学视觉-语言模型
translated_abstract: 采用对比图文预训练的生物医学视觉-语言模型（VLMs）的发展一直依赖于不断扩大且日益多样化的图文数据集的规模。除了规模化之外，进一步的进展还可以来自从现有数据中学习更丰富的表示。我们假设科学文献本身的结构提供了额外的监督来源：图、子图（面板）、图注以及伴随的文章文本编码了丰富的跨模态关系。然而，将这些内容视为相互独立的图文对忽略了它们之间的关系。为了解决这一局限，我们将这些结构关系纳入对比图文监督中。我们在保留精确图文匹配的同时，为相关配对（例如某个子图与其同级子图的图注）引入较弱的正样本监督。我们还对同一内容类型的跨文章负样本进行加权，以促使模型学习更精细的区分能力。我们还……
tldr: BioLoom通过挖掘科学文章内部的结构关系（如子图与同级图注之间的关联、同类内容的跨文章负样本），在对比图文预训练中引入弱正样本监督与加权负样本，从而在不增加数据规模的情况下提升生物医学视觉-语言模型的表示能力。
en_tdlr: BioLoom improves biomedical vision-language models by leveraging the structural relationships within scientific articles—such as panels and sibling captions—introducing weak positive supervision and weighted cross-article negatives in contrastive pretraining to learn richer representations beyond data scaling alone.
